lens: Community CRM - history and redesign diagnosis
title: Root cause, stated once: four redesigns changed paint and placement; none changed the model
location: index.html cr-ch2-script / cr-cc-script / cr-cpartners-script / cr-nbid-script; docs/CR_COMMUNITY_AUDIT_2026-08.md; docs/cardinal_build_log.md builds 278, 299, 359, 433, 705-714, 802-804
evidence: The record shows 4 full redesigns (Frost 271-315, Slate & Clay 351-364, green/two-party 427-441, black-card port 700-714) plus a declutter pass (802-804), and an identity that literally went full circle: green (builds 179-180) -> Frost ice-blue (299) -> Slate & Clay light (359) -> green dark (433) -> black card (705). Five things survived every one of them, each re-confirmed in the build-965 file: (1) partner identity in three storage shapes; (2) the retail stage machine wearing community renames through >=4 divergent label maps; (3) a hub of counters whose headline number ('Open bids' = d.all.length, no stage filter) cannot change when work changes; (4) two opposite amount-precedence rules on the two surfaces Theo compares; (5) the suspend seam - 6 of 9 Job Menu tiles still leave the black card for shared retail-skinned chrome, and the menu itself is mirrored from the dead legacy #jaGrid. Theo's own words track the invariants, not the paint: 10 Aug 'it just feels messy and somewhat confusing', 21 Aug 'It's the third time I changed it. It just doesn't feel right to me.'
rec: The fifth change should be to the record, not the skin: one partner-identity writer, one amount resolver, a community-native stage narrative, and hub numbers that are doors. Every item below is a piece of that; none of them is a restyle.

lens: Community CRM (hub cr-ch2, black card cr-cc, New Bid cr-nbid
title: The pipeline has never moved: 15/15 jobs at Lead, and the submit door only exists if a builder estimate does
location: index.html <script id="cr-cc-script">: threadHtml() Lead branch (acts: est ? …), ccDoAct('logsub'), liveEstimate()
evidence: Live DB 21 Aug: 15 community jobs, all stage Lead (was 16/16 on 10 Aug); only 2 have estimates; 7 carry a typed lead.bid_amount; 3 are past bid_due_at. In cr-cc-script threadHtml, the Lead branch is `acts: est ? [{label:'Mark it submitted',how:'submitted'},{label:'Open the bid',how:'open'}] : [{label:'Price it',how:'estimate'}]` — with no liveEstimate() the ONLY offered action is 'Price it', so the 13 jobs priced outside the builder (typed bid_amount in the New Bid modal) have no way to be marked submitted from the card. The Bid tab's 'Log submitted' (ccDoAct 'logsub') records submitted_amount but never calls setStage, so even logging the amount leaves the job reading 'Bid Requested'. Build 710 shipped 'Mark it submitted' 10 days ago and adoption is zero — the gate, not the button, is the blocker.
rec: Key the submit affordance on ANY recorded price — liveEstimate() OR lead.bid_amount OR bid.submitted_amount — and make 'Log submitted' offer the stage move (it already stamps submitted_at). A Lead with a typed amount should read 'Bid ready to submit', not 'Bid needs pricing'.

lens: Community CRM - history and redesign diagnosis
title: Partner identity still has three storage shapes; the attach path writes a field no display reads
location: index.html: cr-cpartners-script async function setPartnerForProject; cr-ch2-script function partnerOf; main markup select#ldPartner + the 'partner:' key in the New Lead save payload
evidence: Confirmed at 965 by reading shipped code: setPartnerForProject (cr-cpartners-script) writes ck.lead.partner_id ONLY ('if(partnerId) ck.lead.partner_id = partnerId'); the hub's partnerOf() (cr-ch2-script) returns 'l.partner_name || "No partner recorded"' and every Bill-to cell renders l.partner_name; only the New Bid form writes both (partner_name: partner.name). So attaching Habitat via the black card's own Partner section (built at 706) still leaves the hub saying 'No partner recorded'. Third shape: the New Lead form still ships a hardcoded 6-option #ldPartner select ('Habitat For Humanity'...'Dayton Home Repair Network') saved as a bare 'partner:' string no community screen reads. This is CR-COM-008 verbatim, raised 10 Aug, explicitly listed as 'still open: partner identity (008)' in OPEN_ITEMS after the port, and unchanged 255 builds later. It is why the bid-email guardrail (which keys on partner_id) skips exactly the jobs most likely to be wrong.
rec: Data-model fix, not a screen fix: one write path that resolves the roster row and writes partner_id AND partner_name together (and a read-time join as backstop); replace the hardcoded #ldPartner list with the roster; one-time backfill of the live rows (id-only and bare-string jobs). Until this lands, every future redesign will still render 'No partner recorded' over real partners.

lens: Community CRM - history and redesign diagnosis
title: Money still has no single source: the hub and the card disagree about which number is 'the amount'
location: index.html cr-ch2-script function bidAmt; cr-cc-script renderInner 'var amt = est ? est.total ...'; cr-cc-script outcome save 'lp.funded_by = ...'
evidence: Confirmed at 965: cr-ch2-script bidAmt() returns 'Number(l.bid_amount) || Number(estTot[pr.id]) || 0' (hand-typed first); the black card's renderInner computes 'amt = est ? est.total : (Number(l.bid_amount) || 0)' (estimate first) - opposite precedence on the two surfaces Theo looks at side by side, and neither labels whose number it is (CR-COM-011, listed open after the port). Companions still open: CR-COM-012 (Bid-tab line items read price where rows carry unit_price/amount, so lines print $0 under a correct total) and CR-COM-009 - confirmed at 965 that the outcome step writes lp.funded_by only (no partner_id/partner_name write near it), so recording who funded the award never changes who gets billed.

Fix the Bid-tab field names (unit_price/amount) in the same pass.

title: Publish / → Contract / Mark-as-Sent read window.currentProject, not the open estimate's own project
location: index.html — <script id="cr-epub-script"> handlePublishClick(); <script id="cr-e2c-script"> handleClick(); <script id="cr-ess-script"> hookPublish(); reachable via creOpenSaved() in <script id="cr-estimates-script">
evidence: cr-epub handlePublishClick: `var projectBefore = window.currentProject` then `loadForProject(projectBefore.id)`; cr-e2c handleClick: `var project = window.currentProject`; cr-ess hookPublish: `var project = window.currentProject`. But CardinalEstimates.openEditor() never writes window.currentProject, and the Estimates screen (Menu → Estimates → creOpenSaved) opens any saved estimate via `est.openEditor(r.data.project_id, r.data)` without touching it. With a stale currentProject, pickEstimate(rows, openId) finds no id match in the wrong project's rows and falls back to rows[0] — publishing/contracting the WRONG client's newest estimate; with none open, `projectBefore.id` throws and the rep sees 'Publish failed: Cannot read properties of null'. The correct pattern exists one function above: openPreview() does `window.CardinalEstimates.currentProject() || window.currentProject`.
rec: Capture `window.CardinalEstimates.currentProject() || window.currentProject` (openPreview's own pattern) in all three modules before the save click, and have pickEstimate refuse the rows[0] fallback when the project ids disagree — a wrong-client contract is worse than an error message.

lens: Insurance/Claims CRM end to end: claim creation → scope of l
title: Supplement Desk signs non-admins out of the entire CRM (shared Supabase session + signOut on the admin check)
location: supplement.html showApp() (the `sb.auth.signOut()` after the is_cardinal_admin check) + index.html #navMenu Insurance section (`data-nav="desk"` row, ungated) + the navopt dispatch `else if(nav === 'desk'){ window.location.href = '/supplement.html'; }`
evidence: index.html menu row `<button class="navopt" data-nav="desk">Supplement Desk</button>` is visible to every user in the insurance portal (hideAdminItemsForNonAdmin() hides only reports/feed/settings; syncPortalSections() gates the Insurance section by portal, not role). Tapping it runs `window.location.href='/supplement.html'` — same origin as the app. supplement.html builds its client with `createClient(SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)` (default storageKey) and index.html's main client is also default (`var sb = TEAM ? window.supabase.createClient(...)`), so both read the SAME stored session. showApp() then runs `var adm = await sb.rpc('is_cardinal_admin'); if(adm.error || adm.data !== true){ ... await sb.auth.signOut(); }` — supabase-js v2 signOut defaults to scope 'global', revoking the user's refresh tokens everywhere and clearing the shared token. Verified live: team_profiles has 7 non-admin accounts (curtis/scottie production, 5 sales) who all fail is_cardinal_admin. The admin-facing 'Sign out' button in the Desk header does the same to admins. This is exactly why the Visualizer got its own `storageKey:'cr-viz-auth'`; the Desk never did.
rec: Never signOut a shared session on a failed admin check — show the 'admin-only' message and a Back-to-app link instead. Either give the Desk its own storageKey (the cr-viz-auth precedent) or hide/badge the menu row for non-admins (the role is already knowable via the same rpc the Desk calls).

lens: Interaction states app-wide — empty, loading, error, confirm
title: Offline outbox silently drops server-refused writes, then flashes green 'All changes synced'
location: index.html <script id="cr-outbox-script"> — flush() ('dropping a refused write'), badge() (the `_lastPending > 0` done-flash), networkish(); punch photo path: flushPhotos() ('dropping a photo that was refused') in the punch-card block near the crToastErr('Could not save this photo…') site
evidence: In cr-outbox-script flush(): a non-networkish failure hits `console.warn('[outbox] dropping a refused write:', row.table, r.error.message)` then `del(row.id)` — no toast, no badge state, no window.report. badge() then sees the queue drained and, because `_lastPending > 0` (only the logout wipe resets it, and the flash does not check `sentSome`), paints the 'done' state: 'All changes synced' in green for 2.6s. The punch photo outbox has the identical shape: flushPhotos() logs '[photo-outbox] dropping a photo that was refused:' and pDel()s the blob. networkish() matches only /load failed|failed to fetch|networkerror|network request failed|timed? ?out|fetch/i — so an RLS refusal, a constraint failure, or a 401 'JWT expired' (plausible on the very first flush after the 'online' event, racing the token refresh after a long offline stretch) all classify as 'refused' and are deleted. The optimistic cache overlay (patchesFor) stops the moment the entry is deleted, so the edit reverts on the next reload with zero explanation.
rec: Add a fifth badge state — red 'N changes could not sync — tap to see' — instead of deleting refused entries: move them to a dead-letter list the tap opens (record name, field, reason, Retry/Discard). At minimum gate the green flash on `sentSome && nothing dropped`, route the drop through showError()/window.report so it is at least visible and logged, and retry once after supabase-js finishes its token refresh before classifying a 401 as a refusal. A crew that queues edits on a roof must never watch a green 'All changes synced' while an edit was thrown away.

lens: Interaction states app-wide — empty, loading, error, confirm
title: Claims, Coach and auto-stage toasts are painted behind #pwaNav in the installed app — saves, deletes and their errors show nothing on the phone
location: index.html <style> rules for #cr-claims-mount .cr-c-toast, #cr-coach-mount .cr-k-toast, .cr-ess-toast, .cr-toast; toast() functions in the claims block, cr-coach block, cr-ess block; #pwaNav base rule + body.standalone #pwaNav{z-index:9990 !important}

rec: Route these module toasts through the app-wide crToast/window.toast (which already reserves 76px+safe-area under body.standalone and sits at z 99999) — build 735 already adopted the window.toast name for exactly this migration; or copy #crToasts' body.standalone offset onto each.
